posts.cooked: I will say that this expansion is way better than Rook City. (Don’t get me wrong, Rook City is also very enjoyable, it’s just the villians other than Spite tend to annoy me when playing with some people that don’t grasp the way to beat them no matter how many times they have faced them and playing solo there is just too much stuff going on at the same time.) I’ll also say that the artwork is just fantastic. Really can’t wait to see what Adam pulls out for the next expansion.
